title: Decode: Cannot read properties of undefined
why_it_matters: It's the most common JavaScript error you will ever see.
explanation: This error means the thing before the dot is undefined or null. The message names the property you tried to read. Work backwards: where was this variable supposed to get its value? Usually the data hasn't loaded yet, or the name is wrong.
try_it: Trigger this error on purpose, then fix it with optional chaining.
